title: Shotgun metagenomic characterization of a wastewater treatment plant residue used as a carrier for plant growth-promoting bacteria in Lupinus albus
description: This project contains shotgun metagenomic sequencing data generated to characterize a wastewater treatment plant (WWTP)-derived residue evaluated as an organic carrier for plant growth-promoting bacteria (PGPB) in a Lupinus albus biofertilization assay. The main sample corresponds to the WWTP-derived residue (EDARCAR), and a baseline control soil sample from the Lupinus assay (W0S0CAR; low-Hg soil, water-irrigated and uninoculated) was included as a descriptive reference.The dataset was used to assess the taxonomic composition and functional annotation potential of the WWTP-derived residue, including annotations related to carbohydrate-active enzymes, antibiotic resistance, metal and biocide resistance, and mercury mer-system genes. These annotations are based on sequence homology and represent genetic potential inferred from shotgun metagenomic data; they do not constitute evidence of phenotypic resistance, virulence, pathogenicity or biosafety risk.
